event.notes: "name" is matched as a substring against ESPN's own event name (punctuation and case are ignored), and the FIRST match in the scoreboard window wins. For a one-off card "UFC 330" is unique and enough. For a weekly series it is not: ESPN lists every Contender Series week inside the 45-day lookahead, so the name must carry the season and week or the run will silently price the wrong card. Discovery pulls recent uploads from each capper channel and keeps the ones whose title matches settings.discovery.title_contains. Add entries to "videos" only to pin a specific video by hand.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: Feels quite confident and doesn't mind parlaying Rodriguez: big speed and striking advantage over a very hittable Miller with sketchy durability.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Called it a squash match and his top most confident pick — Rodriguez's explosive power striking is far too much for the outclassed grappler Miller.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Rodriguez is better everywhere; Miller only has a power advantage and doesn't show much skill.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Taking the untested Brazilian at face value — big, jacked, 27 and in his prime with a size advantage, while Miller looked cheeks on his last Contender Series appearance.

cappers.name: Couch Warrior Podcast
cappers.reasoning: Doesn't think either guy is UFC level, but expects the athletic, powerful Rodriguez to knock out the sloppy, non-durable Miller in round one and create a future fade opportunity.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Called his highest confidence pick of the card: Rodriguez has huge power in hands and kicks, Miller is shorter, hittable, with chin and cardio concerns after being battered by Goundry.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Miller is stiff, awkward and easily hit despite durability; Rodriguez is a decent, physically imposing striker who can walk him down and finish, likely in round one or two.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Crisp boxing combinations plus leg and body kicks should make Miller stationary and lead to a knockout.

cappers.name: MMA Prediction Guru
cappers.reasoning: Leaning Rodriguez as the better athlete and more dangerous striker; Miller is too hittable and his wrestling isn't good enough to justify the upset, so a head kick or hook along the fence finish is likely.

options.selection: Douglas Rodriguez by KO in round 1

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: Believes Rodriguez finds Miller's chin early given the speed and power edge and Miller's questionable durability.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects Rodriguez to land big shots early and finish Miller in the first round.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Rodriguez has size, power, speed and striking advantages similar to Ryan Gandra who battered Miller, but he warns not to max bet since Rodriguez is helpless off his back.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Puga has great overall boxing and a purple belt in jiu-jitsu, with takedown defense and scrambling ability to handle Trembley's grappling.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Trembley started MMA late, has faced nobody of note and mostly submits opponents, while Puga is a young Mexican knockout artist who has never been submitted.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Puga is the much better boxer with body work and professional boxing experience, and although his initial takedown defense is suspect he scrambles very well back to his feet.

cappers.name: Couch Warrior Podcast
cappers.reasoning: Loves Puga's boxing, jab, hand speed and body work, and thinks his slick brown-belt jiu-jitsu will let him stay active off his back and get back to his feet against Trembley's clinch/wrestling pressure.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Puga is the crafty, slicker striker with solid takedown defense and good jiu-jitsu, so Trembly's wrestling shouldn't dominate and Puga should win the standup exchanges.

cappers.name: MMA Prediction Guru
cappers.reasoning: Mentioned possibly just playing the Trembley moneyline (or a submission prop) since he is the more well-rounded fighter with a harder build-up.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: Puga's boxing superiority against a hittable, aggressive Trembley who crashes the pocket; capper trusts Puga's grappling defense to stay out of trouble if taken down.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Puga is a legitimate boxing threat with striking finishes; Sam said he'll take the KO if it's plus money.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Trembley is very hittable and Puga's boxing should eventually put his lights out.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Puga is a pressure boxer who works the body and uses his size and reach well, and Tremblay's defense can be exposed; Puga can also scramble back up if taken down.

options.selection: Tanner Trembley by submission (2nd round rear-naked choke)

cappers.name: MMA Prediction Guru
cappers.reasoning: Trembley is more well-rounded, has better competition on his resume, great conditioning and a strong finishing/submission game; he should force exchanges, mix in takedowns and get Puga out of there.

options.selection: Roman Puga by KO in round 2

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: He thinks Puga's boxing and body shots will accumulate on Tremblay and break him down in the second round.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Called Perez the lock of the card — far more skilled, showed the real deal against Manuel Sosa, while Paxton is a meat-and-potatoes wrestler who's beaten only tin cans.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Most confident pick and lock parlay leg: Perez has faced better competition and has solid striking plus a strong ground game, while Paxton built his record on cans.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Most competitive fight of the night, but Perez's own wrestling, jiu-jitsu and superior boxing should keep it standing where he wins.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Perez is notably faster on the feet and his grappling is strong, though Paxton's size and Perez's cardio issues are concerns.

cappers.name: Couch Warrior Podcast
cappers.reasoning: Picks Perez by decision as the cleaner striker and grappler, but calls it a 'dog or pass' for betting purposes since Paxton's grinding wrestling could make it close and ugly.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: Surprised the line is this wide; Paxton's forward pressure, clinch work and cardio should wear Perez down, and Paxton's chin should hold up early against Perez's better striking.

cappers.name: MMA Prediction Guru
cappers.reasoning: Named as his most confident play of the week; Paxton is a nice little underdog, a grinder with pressure, power and wrestling who can break Perez, who gasses and lacks striking confidence.

options.selection: Christian Perez by submission in the first two rounds

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Perez is far more skilled and should cook Paxton, whose only path is takedowns and ground and pound.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: He likes Perez's grappling after what he did to Manel Sousa early, but Perez gassed late so the finish should come in rounds one or two.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Perez showed elite offensive grappling against Manuel Sousa and comes in off a short layoff, though Jacob is less confident due to Paxton's size, wrestling and likely good cardio.

cappers.name: MMA Prediction Guru
cappers.reasoning: Predicts Paxton wins a 29-28 decision by breaking Perez and winning the later rounds; also floated a late KO/decision prop.

options.selection: Christian Perez by KO/TKO in round 2

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Paxton swings wild and sloppy; Perez lands the better combinations to the body and head and finishes in the second round.

options.selection: Logan Paxton by TKO in round 3

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: Expects Paxton to wear Perez down (Perez gassed in round three of his prior DWCS fight) and get a late finish.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Most confident pick and lock parlay leg: Fazil's forward pressure and combinations should overwhelm Brito, who he expects to slow down and crumble, possibly by TKO or club-and-sub.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Fazil has the better overall skills and should have been in the UFC already, mixing takedowns with striking; Brito is a live dog though.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Fazil has the better submission game, a nice boxing base and high volume for three rounds; he should win if he keeps pressure and avoids fighting at Brito's distance.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Brito is battle tested against real European competition while Fazil has been can crushing on a much weaker circuit; the fake tough guy act at the faceoff flipped Sam onto Brito.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Fazil is a slow starter and defensively unsound while Brito is the more technical, one-punch-at-a-time striker who should land something big early.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Expects Fazil to mix combinations and takedowns well and finish by knockout in a competitive fight.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: He leans toward a submission win for Fazil, likely in the second or third round, since Fazil is much more dangerous on the ground.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: Fasil's pressure and pocket-crashing should make Brito uncomfortable against the cage until one of the big shots flatlines him.

cappers.name: MMA Prediction Guru
cappers.reasoning: Favors Fasil in a striking battle because of better fundamentals when both tire; Brito starts well but gasses, and isn't a good enough wrestler to win that way.
